decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The retention of the existing shelter, and the proposed use of the site for a commercial car wash, by reason of the incompatible nature of the use and the size, position and appearance of the existing structure, and the narrow vehicular access, would represent an unacceptable backland development, which would result in a loss of amenity to adjoining residential properties through noise and disturbance, loss of outlook and shading. The proposal is contrary to policy ENV.1.1, ENV P.1.5, ENV P.1.7, E.1.1, T.1.4 and T.2.2 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003).

Condition : 2 - The retention of the existing shelter, by reason of its size, appearance, materials and position adjacent to the boundary with St Stephens Conservation Area, would harm the character and appearance of the area and would fail to preserve or enhance the setting of the conservation area, contrary to policy ENV-B.2.2 of the Council's Unitary Development Plan (Adopted December 2003).
description: Retention of a detached single storey structure in the rear for proposed use as a commercial car wash.
